title: Add a flag to expose undeclared test outputs in unzipped form.

timeline.body: Not sure whether internal code relies on this name. Please keep an eye on the internal usages and tests when importing.

reply.body: Thanks for the heads up. The preexisting constant must stay. I've also made changes to handle the zipped/unzipped cases differently, as some internal code relies on the zip file (not the directory) being a spawn output.

timeline.body: Since we had this issue when developing, I think we can also add a test for the case that changing the value of `--zip_undeclared_test_outputs` will rerun the test.

FYI, we usually start with `experimental_` for a new feature flag and set its default value to `false` if it is a boolean value. But in this case, calling `zip_undeclared_test_outputs` and defaulting to `true` make more sense.

timeline.message:
Add a flag to expose undeclared test outputs in unzipped form.

Closes #14568.
